newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - APL stock cut to avoid.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - APL stock cut to avoid.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it lowered its rating on the shares of APL Ltd to avoid from neutral because of concerns related to the approval of its proposed merger with Neptune Orient Lines Ltd.

-- Analyst Stewart Scharf said in a research note he was concerned about whether a foreign company could control a U.S. shipper, after the U.S. government rejected Canadian Pacific Ltd's proposal to acquire U.S. carrier Lykes Bros.
-- "Similar concerns about foreign control of a U.S. shipper could nix Singapore's Neptune Orient Lines bid for APL," he said.
-- APL's stock was down 1-1/4 at 29-1/2 Monday afternoon.
